messages:
jess_prod: quick follow-up from the eviction postmortem. we keep hitting a repeating kv-eviction spike at P95 under synthetic load. want to convert remediation into a small, owned test suite: quick CI fault-injector, nightly tenant-blast, focused promptset evals, and a tabletop/chaos drill. owners below.
oliver_sre: +1. CI step must be fast (<8m) and non-destructive. we should run fault-injection as an optional canary on PRs, required on release merges.
mina_ml: I can own the promptset and eval harness. goal: capture long-context churn and concurrent short-query storms. ETA: 3 weeks. creating RINF-5010.
luke_platform: Ill own CI fault-inject + nightly tenant-blast (k6 -> k8s). will add cost caps and a small prober to run post-deploy. creating RINF-5011.
jess_prod: soft deadlines: CI PR by 2025-02-10, promptset in nightly by 2025-02-28, tenant-blast integrated by 2025-03-07, chaos drill runbook by 2025-03-21. please tag tickets with "postmortem-eval" and link the postmortem.
mina_ml: sample prompt snippets I'll put in RINF-5010 repo: PROMPT_X: multi-turn 12k context with repeated backrefs; PROMPT_Y: 100 concurrent short queries same convo id. METRICS: eviction-rate, p95, quality-proxy.
oliver_sre: CI fault injection plan: flip a feature flag to lower KV cache size for 30s during a CI job, monitor eviction-rate and p95. keep it behind a toggle so we can opt-out on flaky days.
luke_platform: tenant-blast plan: ramp 10->200 users over 12m, sustain 90m, run in two modes (hosted-only, hosted+dedicated) to validate routing fallbacks. infra checklist and cost estimate in RINF-5011.
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "Eviction test owners sync" Wed 09:30 PT  link: https://calendar.redwood/eviction-owners-sync
jess_prod: schedule 30m sync to unblock infra creds and finalize failure gates: Wed 09:30 PT. escalate blockers to eng-sre + finance and cc me. closing action summary: RINF-5010 (promptset+eval) RINF-5011 (CI+load) RINF-5012 (chaos+runbook). update tickets when PRs open. thanks :thumbsup:
